turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: How do you feel about pricing relative to the value you're getting?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It's fair for what it replaces — we used to pay a voice actor by the hour for every ad read. Even at current prices we're saving money and turning ads around same-day instead of same-week.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Anything about billing that's been confusing?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: The usage dashboard lags behind actual billing by about a day, so we can't always tell in real time if we're about to hit a tier limit.
